data.narrative:
Tandem PV is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher. The company has raised approximately $87M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, none of these peers fall into sufficiently narrow comparability buckets—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—to support a reliable peer-median valuation approach; at least three comparable datapoints are required, and the tight filters yielded zero matches.

Consequently, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $87M total raised as a proxy for post-Series A valuation. This method assumes typical venture step-up economics between Series A and subsequent rounds and yields an implied valuation of $174M.

The triangulated valuation range is $148M to $200M, centered on a $174M median. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty given the absence of same-stage or adjacent-stage peer comparables. Key risks to valuation include technology development progress, capital intensity of commercialization, and the limited visibility into how Tandem PV's technical position compares to the broader frontier-energy peer set.
